title: Muraja'ah: linking Al-Muddaththir 1 to 37: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Muddaththir and madd in recitation
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 20. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised

questions.q: Breakout pairs: 'start anywhere' check across 74:1 to 37 (start ayat on the pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 74:1 to 37 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner records starts and prompts; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: write the first word of 74:31 to 37 from memory.
questions.a: وَمَا, كَلَّا, وَٱلَّيْلِ, وَٱلصُّبْحِ, إِنَّهَا, نَذِيرًا, لِمَن
A) وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ. 74:31 begins وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ.

questions.q: Think again: Where in Al-Muddaththir do you most often lose your place? Why there?
questions.a: Usually at joints between sections or where ayat look alike (74:19 and 74:20).
